final_candidates.decision_summary: Tryptophan at position 95 is in the conserved active site region (PLYIDVTWHPAGD) and likely stacks with the FAD isoalloxazine ring; alanine substitution removes the aromatic ring needed for FAD binding and electron transfer.

Histidine at position 96 is adjacent to W95 in the catalytic domain active site and likely participates in acid-base catalysis or FAD coordination; alanine substitution removes the imidazole needed for proton transfer.

stop_reason.detail: After correcting all Round 0 errors and verifying residue positions against the provided sequence, the top 3 candidates target distinct mechanistic aspects (FAD binding, catalysis, nucleotide binding) and further self-iteration cannot improve confidence without external evidence.
